parts.text: The people around you decide your future more than your goals do.
You set a goal. You get excited. You tell your friends.
And they say: why would you do that? Just relax.
Because the people around you are like a rope. You can't see it, but it holds you in place.
There's a famous idea, often credited to Jim Rohn: you become the average of the five people you spend the most time with.
That doesn't mean you drop everyone. It means you choose more carefully.
Spend time with people who are already where you want to go. Watch them. Ask them questions.
And if you can't find them yet, find them in books.
